rationale: All 8 start runs are feasible with wide headroom (0 DRC, hold +0.05-0.11 ns, slew/cap <=19 pins vs bar 295), so only T_eff matters. AREA 3 dominates: its five runs give 7.55-8.39 ns versus 8.9-12.4 ns for DELAY 3/4 and AREA 2. The two best (7.55, 7.64) share timing-driven placement, no routability-driven placement, cap213 RC and post-GRT timing repair; the weaker AREA 3 runs used routability-driven placement with stock/orfs RC, two without timing-driven placement. Tighter targets also scored better and make T_eff more honest for the re-run, so pin period_frac 0.45 (8.59 ns, nearest allowed to ~7.6 ns). Utilisation, density, synthesis buffering/sizing, margins and repair limits stay free to explore.
